name: dhis2/analytics
what_it_is: A shared React component and utility library (@dhis2/analytics) powering DHIS2 analytics apps (dashboards, data visualizer, maps, line listing). Provides reusable UI components, layout modules, visualization builders, and API helpers.
constraints: Host app must supply all peer dependencies
Chart rendering delegates to Highcharts (license applies)
API helpers need live DHIS2 instance
